notes: Posted 4 July 2001, before Coruscant; the list has no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

Starting cards as posted under 'Starting (8)' (seven are listed): Massassi Base Operations / One In A Million, Yavin 4, Yavin 4: Docking Bay, Heading For The Medical Frigate, Strike Planning, Squadron Assignments and Great Shot, Kid!; these count toward the total. The three Effects are pulled by Heading For The Medical Frigate, so no single starting effect is shown.

Posted 'Yavin IV ...' dested the Yavin 4 pages; 'Death Star' and 'Kiffex' in a Light deck dested the Light pages Death Star (Special Edition) and Kiffex (Jabba's Palace); 'Yavin IV Sentry' dested Yavin Sentry; 'Boussh' dested Boushh; 'Great Shot, Kid' dested Great Shot, Kid!.

The headings 'Red (6)' (Control & Tunnel Vision x2, Tunnel Vision x4, Yavin Sentry) and 'Crazy Crap (4)' (Attack Run, Enhanced Proton Torpedoes, I'll Take The Leader x2) are section headers, not cards; removed.
Total is 59 as published (section headers 8 + 10 + 18 + 13 + 6 + 4 = 59; the Starting section lists 7 cards and the 'Red' section 7), not 60; kept as published.

The strategy's EDIT swaps Grondorn Muse, 'Yavin 4 Sentry x2' and BoShek for Goo Nee Tay, Corporal Kensaric, Colonel Cracken and Ellors Madak; the list above is as posted, before the edit. The author's later DeckTech list MBO Isn't As Slow As You Think (17345, 7 July 2001) is a revision of this deck.
